name: Rongsheng Petrochemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Rongsheng Petrochemical Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of chemical, oil, and polyester products in China. It also provides polyolefins, aromatics, chemical and oil products, etc., which are widely used in covering new energy; new materials; organic chemicals; synthetic fibers, resins, and rubber; oil products, and other fields. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Hangzhou, China. Rongsheng Petrochemical Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Zhejiang Rongsheng Holding Group Co., Ltd.
